Hi Sarah —

Thanks — attaching the pen-test summary now and answering your SLA questions below. Happy to execute an NDA if that will help for the full report; we can loop Legal.

Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (stub)

Redwood vulnerability management & pen-test basics (summary):
- Third-party pen test: Annual, performed by an external provider. Most recent full external pen-test: 2025-09-20. We have a short summary attached; we can provide the full report under NDA.
- Internal & automated scanning: Weekly authenticated scans against staging and production mirroring customer-facing surfaces; monthly full infrastructure scans.
- CI/CD security gates: SAST + dependency scanning on merge; failing high/critical findings are blocked from release until remediated or mitigated.
- SLA / remediation targets (typical):
  * Critical (CVSS >=9 or exploited): 24 hours to mitigation plan and 72 hours to remediation or documented compensating control
  * High (CVSS 7-8.9): 7 calendar days to mitigation plan, 30 days to remediation depending on risk and availability windows
  * Medium/Low: tracked in backlog; remediation target 30–90 days depending on priority
- Disclosure process: We use a coordinated disclosure channel with customers for confirmed vulnerabilities; we prefer a private channel (email + secure file share) and will coordinate a joint public disclosure only after both parties agree on timing. We also have a security@redwood.ai mailbox for reporting and a dedicated contact for vendor disclosures (Neha Kapoor).

Docs & links: vendor questionnaire intake: https://redwood.app/vendor-questionnaire/initiate/ACME-01
Security docs folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RedwoodSecurityDocs

If you confirm NDA, I can have Legal send a mutual NDA later today and we can share the full pen-test report. For the call Wed 18 Mar 10:00 AM PT — that works for me; sending a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
